_note: Capability descriptions summarised from Excelra's public product and service pages. Used only as a rule-matching table: an item is linked to an asset when the trigger conditions below match. No inference, no model.

assets.name: GOSTAR
assets.full_name: Global Online Structure Activity Relationship database
assets.summary: Expert-curated structure–activity relationship data across global small-molecule chemical space, linking chemical structure to measured biological activity.
assets.supports: Hit finding, lead optimisation, competitor scaffold benchmarking and patent-landscape analysis.
assets.contribution: Benchmark the disclosed chemotype against curated SAR for the same target class and surface competing series, freedom-to-operate pressure points and selectivity liabilities.
assets.value: Answers 'is this chemistry actually differentiated?' in hours instead of a multi-week manual literature and patent review.

assets.name: GOBIOM
assets.summary: Manually curated biomarker database spanning pre-clinical, clinical and exploratory biomarkers across therapy areas.
assets.supports: Biomarker strategy, patient stratification, endpoint selection and companion-diagnostic planning.
assets.contribution: Compare the endpoint and stratification strategy against curated biomarker precedent in the same indication to explain why a readout landed where it did.
assets.value: Turns a competitor's endpoint miss into a reusable design lesson for a client's own protocol.

assets.name: Data Curation & FAIRification
assets.full_name: Expert data curation and FAIR data services
assets.summary: Manual and semi-automated curation that turns fragmented public and proprietary life-sciences data into interoperable, analysis-ready assets.
assets.supports: Building trustworthy internal data layers for analytics, reporting and downstream modelling.
assets.contribution: Scope the curation layer this kind of programme depends on: source coverage, ontology mapping, provenance and refresh cadence.
assets.value: Removes the hidden data-preparation cost that sits under every analytics or discovery initiative.

assets.name: Bioinformatics & Multiomics
assets.summary: Disease-landscape analysis, NGS and multiomics pipeline development, and translational data interpretation.
assets.supports: Target identification, mechanism-of-action work and translational programmes.
assets.contribution: Rebuild the omics evidence chain behind the claim and test whether the target rationale holds across independent public datasets.
assets.value: Independent validation of a competitor's target thesis before a client commits capital to the same biology.

assets.name: Commercial & Pipeline Analytics
assets.summary: Structured tracking of competitor pipelines, trial activity and strategic moves for commercial and medical teams.
assets.supports: Portfolio reviews, launch planning and medical-information readiness.
assets.contribution: Translate the event into portfolio impact: which competing assets gain room, which lose it, and what the medical-information team should expect to field.
assets.value: Gives commercial and medical teams the same evidence base on the same day the news lands.
